entry.title: fix(settings): keep an install failure on one readable status line
entry.content:
fix(settings): keep an install failure on one readable status line

The nine set_*_status methods are handed str(exc) on failure, and an exception
is not a status line: the macOS dyld error in the v3.1.0 report is three lines,
the QLabel rendered all three, and the card cut them at its right edge — the
screenshot could not be read to find the missing symbol.

FormPanel.set_status_text collapses whitespace runs to one line, caps it at 140
characters, and puts the verbatim original in the tooltip. Short translated
statuses are byte-identical, tooltip included.

Not ElidingLabel: its rendered text depends on pixel width, and ~60 tests assert
these labels' text() verbatim.

entry.title: feat(packs): never offer a wheel the running macOS cannot load
entry.content:
feat(packs): never offer a wheel the running macOS cannot load

A macOS wheel tag is a hard dyld floor, and nothing honoured it: artifact
selection keys on (sys.platform, machine) only, and every CI runner is current.

- ArtifactSpec.min_macos / _OnnxWheelSpec.min_macos read the floor off the
  pinned filename, so it can never drift from the wheel being downloaded.
- artifact_for and _current_spec decline a wheel above the host's release; the
  pack row then hides exactly as it does on an unpinned platform.
- onnxruntime's arm64 wheel moves to 1.23.2 (macosx_13_0). The table stays
  versioned per platform: 1.23.2 has no win_arm64 cp312 wheel, so a wholesale
  downpin would drop Windows ARM64 silence removal.
- New test asserts every required macOS pin loads on the app's own floor
  (PyQt6-Qt6's macosx_11_0_arm64) and pins onnxruntime as the one gated
  exception. It fails on the pre-fix av pin.

entry.title: fix(asr): re-pin PyAV to the macOS 11 arm64 wheel
entry.content:
fix(asr): re-pin PyAV to the macOS 11 arm64 wheel

- av 17.1.0's arm64 wheel is tagged macosx_14_0; every other arm64 binary we ship is macosx_11_0, so Apple Silicon Macs below macOS 14 got a dyld "Symbol not found … Expected in: AVFoundation.framework" on any faster-whisper import. macOS has no whisper.cpp leg, so that is all of transcription.
- 13.1.0 is the newest release still tagged macosx_11_0 (15.x -> 13_0, 16.x -> 14_0). No abi3 wheel there, hence cp312 pins and abi=(3, 12).
- faster-whisper asks only for av>=11 and uses four APIs stable since av 9.

entry.title: fix(curator): preview the frame the card's screenshot will use
entry.content:
fix(curator): preview the frame the card's screenshot will use

The preview parked on the line's start while extraction grabbed
screenshot_offset seconds later, so for an unpicked word the frame on screen
and the frame on the card were never the same picture.

- _screenshot_instant routes through media_extractor.resolve_screenshot_time,
  against the merged window when a line expansion is active
- a picked word parks on its pick; Reset frame re-parks on the default
- frame_time is a separate keyword so no second-adjusted value can reach the
  manga path's int(start_time) unit index
- CurationMediaContext carries config.screenshot_offset, like audio_padding
- real-ffmpeg test pins that a stamped second extracts that exact frame, and
  the static screenshot's full argv pins -ss before -i
